text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — vendor reports 12 A100 slots available in apac-west for the next 72h. Can we carve out some for the prod canary? cc @Javier @Procurement :eyes:

Javier: Thanks. Is that a soft-hold or a confirmed PO-backed reservation?

Procurement: Soft-hold only at the moment. We can request conversion to a hard reserve but need approval + PO details. PO lead time ~48h.

Kai: Are these A100 40GB or 80GB? Also want to confirm RDMA support — some of the inference containers need it.

Anya: Vendor said A100 80GB, RDMA enabled. I asked for rack IDs and firmware versions, will paste when I get them.

Maria: For the canary we need 4 GPUs for 36h (warmup + 24h smoke). If we get 12 total, reserve 4 for canary, 6 for demo, leave 2 as buffer.

Javier: Sounds reasonable. Can Procurement start the PO for 4 immediately and soft-hold the rest? We don't want other teams to snap them up.

Procurement: On it. Quick checklist for PO: (1) internal cost center (infra-demo), (2) vendor invoice contact, (3) requested start date. Can someone confirm cost center and start date?

Anya: cost center = infra-demo, start date = 2025-01-18 09:00 UTC.

Kai: Adding a small note — please tag the instances with `team=canary` and `priority=high` so autoscaler rules don't touch them. Also ensure quota is bound to `redwood-prod-canary` reservation.

Anya: Will do. Ops runbook snippet for reservation create: ```bash
# create reservation (example)
gcloud compute reservations create redwood-prod-canary --project=my-project --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=4 --zone=asia-west1-a --labels=team=canary,priority=high
```

ops-bot: Reservation request received: ticket #INF-4821 created and assigned to Procurement. ETA for PO conversion: 48h.

Procurement: Submitted soft-hold request and ticket updated. Vendor asked for a signed SOW for hard reserve. I've attached SOW template to the ticket.

Javier: Thx. Once PO flows through, can someone post the reservation ID here? I'll update the rollout playbook.

Maria: Also adding: please set alert if any of the reserved GPUs report ECC errors or high ECC counts during canary. We want to bail fast.

Kai: I'll add a short probe to the smoke tests to check ECC and PCIe link status.

Anya: Great. Action items: Procurement -> follow PO/SOW, Kai -> add smoke probe, Ops -> create reservation and tag, Javier/Maria -> confirm rollout window. I'll ping later today with vendor rack details. :thumbsup:

Javier: LGTM.

Procurement: Updated ticket with SOW link and initial PO draft. Will chase vendor for rack serials.

ops-bot: Ticket #INF-4821 status changed to "awaiting PO".

Anya: Thanks everyone — keep updates here so the oncall can find the latest in one thread.

Maria: Received, will sync once PO confirmed.
